name: Bat Story: Perspective Specialization Guide
description: Supplement to the main cognitive_framework.json, detailing how specific perspectives manifest in the Bat story. Shows transformation of perspectives in nocturnal/diurnal context and contextual truth.

primary_explicit.name: paradoxní
primary_explicit.why_key: Central paradox of truth that is both valid and incompatible with another context
manifestations: Noc není lež, ale jiný jazyk
Pravda, která se nehodí do denního světla
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer C (PHENOMENON) rather than base layer I (TIME) - paradox becomes about the nature of phenomena, not just time

primary_explicit.name: filozofický
primary_explicit.why_key: Raises questions about truth, identity, and the nature of reality across contexts
manifestations: Co je pravda, když závisí na denní době?
Kdo je skutečné já – noční nebo denní?
Co znamená 'žil jsem' přes bolest kocoviny?
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer I (TIME) rather than base layer C (PHENOMENON) - philosophical questions become temporally dependent

primary_explicit.name: psychologický
primary_explicit.why_key: Psychological states of nocturnal ecstasy and morning disidentification
manifestations: Prožitek noci jako svobody a krásy
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer F (ACTION) rather than base layer E (STATE) - psychological states become actions (létání, schovávání)

secondary_implicit.name: metaforický
secondary_implicit.why_key: Rich metaphors throughout (jiný jazyk, kocovina, pavučina)

secondary_implicit.name: meta
secondary_implicit.why_key: Story comments on perception, truth, and the nature of storytelling
manifestations: Reflexe o tom, co je pravda
Příběh o tom, jak příběhy bolí

secondary_implicit.name: kulturní
secondary_implicit.why_key: Cultural symbolism of night, bat, and morning after
manifestations: Noc jako prostor básníků a ztracenců

tertiary_present.name: absurdní
tertiary_present.why_key: Absurdity of continuing to value what no longer fits

tertiary_present.name: asociativní
tertiary_present.why_key: Free associations between noc, krása, trapnost, kocovina

tertiary_present.name: ironický
tertiary_present.why_key: Irony that night's truth is rejected by day

layer_transformations_specific_to_bat.transformation_description: Paradox moves from temporal dimension to become about the nature of phenomena. It's not just that truth changes with time, but that phenomena themselves have different truth values.
layer_transformations_specific_to_bat.story_evidence: Krása v noci je jiný fenomén než krása ve dne – nejde jen o čas, ale o podstatu

layer_transformations_specific_to_bat.transformation_description: Philosophical questions move from being about phenomena to being about time. The question 'what is truth?' becomes 'when is truth?'
layer_transformations_specific_to_bat.story_evidence: Otázka pravdy je neoddělitelná od denní doby – čas určuje platnost

layer_transformations_specific_to_bat.transformation_description: Psychological states move from internal condition to become actions. Noční prožitek není jen stav, je to létání, pohyb, existence.
layer_transformations_specific_to_bat.story_evidence: Netopýr nelétá za potravou, ale 'za atmosférou' – psychologie se stává akcí

perspective_interactions_unique_to_bat.description: Tension between paradox (coexistence of incompatible truths) and philosophy (questions about their nature). Paradox provides the phenomenon, philosophy asks the questions.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_bat.manifestation: Že noc a den mají každý svou pravdu je paradox; že se ptáme 'co to znamená' je filosofie

perspective_interactions_unique_to_bat.description: Psychological experience is expressed through metaphors. Noční prožitek je 'jiný jazyk', ranní bolest je 'kocovina'.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_bat.manifestation: Psychologie potřebuje metafory, aby se vyjádřila

perspective_interactions_unique_to_bat.description: Meta-reflection on truth uses cultural symbols. Přemýšlení o pravdě se děje skrze kulturní archetyp netopýra a noci.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_bat.manifestation: Kulturní symboly jsou nástrojem pro meta-komentář

inverted_woman.description: Žena visící hlavou dolů – paradoxní (převrácená perspektiva), psychologický (její výraz), filozofický (co je nahoře a dole)

web.description: Pavučina – metaforická (síť významů), asociativní (spojení s uvězněním, ochranou), meta (komentář k propojení)

text_with_brackets.description: Text s hranatými závorkami – meta (komentář), paradoxní (přítomnost rána v noci), kulturní (přísloví)

night_absence.description: Nezobrazená noc – paradoxní (přítomná nepřítomností), filozofický (co není vidět), psychologický (prožitek mimo obraz)

ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.i_paradoxical: Can AI hold two incompatible truths as equally valid? Can it accept context-dependent truth?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.c_philosophical: Can AI engage with questions about truth, identity, and context without seeking single answer?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.e_psychological: Can AI understand morning disidentification as natural, not as lying?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.layer_transformations: Can AI detect how perspectives shift layers in nocturnal/diurnal context?

with_fox.contrast: Fox: identity after loss; Bat: truth after context shift

with_fly.contrast: Fly: value inversion; Bat: truth inversion

with_lemur.contrast: Lemur: being seen/invisible; Bat: being true/false by context

with_cows.contrast: Cows: deconstruct language; Bat: deconstruct truth

note: This guide supplements but does not replace cognitive_framework.json. It shows how the universal perspectives manifest specifically in the Bat story's context of nocturnal truth and diurnal rejection.
